svg.aria-label: The region of the angles (t, u), twice: left with level curves of Phi_W, right with level curves of Phi_D, at 0.025, 0.05, 0.1 and 0.15, the cuts t = 0 and u = 0 dashed and the seven vertices marked. Both stresses are positive on the whole region; the smallest value, circled, is at a vertex: 0.0027 for Phi_W at (-2/3, 2/5) and 0.0104 for Phi_D at (-2/3, 0)
